strings.briefing:
Orders and customers from two systems. Make one table that tells the full story of every order.

Nothing is documented. In Python, df holds the orders and customers holds the people; finish with df as the combined table. In SQL, data holds the orders and customers the people; build a table named result and that is what gets judged.
